Approved studio portrait pf MISS ELEANOR MARGARET GREEN.

King Christian of Denmark has consented to public announcement of the betrothal of his kinsman, Prince Viggo, and Miss Eleanor Margaret Green of New York, daughter of James O, Green and grandmother of the late Mr and Mrs Abram S. Hewitt, She is a great-granddaughter of the famous philanthropist inventor, Peter Cooper

Prince Viggo has formally relinquished all claims of succession to the throne of Denmark and will no longer be addressed as "His Royal Highness"; but simply styled "Prince Viggo,Count of Rosenberg. His bride will be Princess Viggo, Countess of Rosenberg. Should they have issue, the children will not be Princes or Princesses; but merely Counts and Countesses.
Prince Viggo is the fourth son of Prince Valdemar, uncle of King Christian. He celebrated his 30th birthday on Christmas Day. 12/28/23

KNUD RASMUSSEN BRINGS BACK ESKIMOS FROM GREENLAND.

S/42,574-RU After three years in the frigid Arctic regions, studying Eskimo life,Knud Rasmussen,Danish explorer,has arrived in the U.S. and is planning to visit some of the larger cities in the country before returning to Denmark. He is seen here at the Danish Legion in Washington with his photographer,Leo Hansen, and two Eskimos whom he has brought with him,both of whom are members of the tribe that accompanied Admiral Peary through Greenland when he began his dash to the North Pole in 1909. Neither of the Eskimos speaks any English.
